data.title: Scaloni: 'Only nostalgia remains' as Messi bids Argentina farewell - ESPN Global
data.content: Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni is confident there is a bright future beyond Lionel Messi, as the team's most influential player of the last two decades prepares to bid farewell, while acknowledging the match will be filled with nostalgia for all those involved. The match will be a celebration of his career, with his teammates from Argentina's triumphant 2022 World Cup squad invited. Alongside the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner, Nicolás Otamendi -- who previously announced his international retirement following the 2026 World Cup --, Giovani Lo Celso and Rodrigo De Paul, Messi's teammate at Inter Miami who had missed out on Scaloni's squad for the first two matches of this FIFA window, also trained with the team the last two days and are expected to start against Benin. Messi, who announced his retirement from international football after Argentina's defeat in the World Cup final, was invited to participate in the friendly.
